evidence.title: Up to 3.2x Faster Inference with LFM2.5-DSpark

summary: The new LFM2.5‑DSpark engine boosts inference speed by as much as 3.2 times compared to prior versions, reducing latency and compute costs. It achieves this gain through optimized kernels and hybrid sparsity techniques and is now available for integration into existing AI pipelines.
title: LFM2.5‑DSpark delivers up to 3.2× faster AI inference
